summary: Candidate is a distinct safety rule for Virtual WAN multiple next hop IP validation with no semantic overlap to existing skills. Existing skills cover different Virtual WAN routing concerns (branch connection consistency, static route next hop validation with hub router IPs, BGP community propagation) and one unrelated Maven repository security rule. The candidate addresses a specific unsupported configuration pattern (public IP or 0.0.0.0/0 coexisting with other next hops to the same appliance) that is not covered by peer candidates or existing skills.
